correctness.rationale: The first complex moment follows from the known wrapped characteristic function. Algebraic expansion yields D=q²θ²/(1+θ²)², the exact inverse and the positive interior Jacobian; the second harmonic gives the explicit positive variance. Bounded triangular CLT yields the drifted Gaussian law. The exact density tangent k-h=-θ∂θ h and uniform Taylor expansion yield H²=O(q⁴) against a nearby composite null; product Hellinger bounds prove indistinguishability below n^-1/4. Standalone checker passed 1732 supporting finite assertions.
